subject: Rolling backup pruning schedule, cross-border transfers & DPA amendment

Cc: compliance@acme-health.com
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Rolling backup/pruning window + DPA question

Marcus / Redwood team —

Thanks for the demo earlier this week. As part of Acme Health's upcoming vendor audit (scheduled for the week of 2028-03-28) we need a clearer picture of your backup pruning and deletion workflows, and any downstream copies that could constitute a cross-border transfer of PHI. Specific asks from audit are below: 

- A timeline for rolling backup pruning and whether there are staged retention windows (snapshots, incremental logs, offsite DR copies).
- How deletes are propagated through subprocessor chains (which subprocessors receive copies, and how soon after deletion those copies are removed).
- Whether you can support a contractual DPA amendment to shorten backup retention for EU-sourced PHI to X days (we'll propose a number in follow-up).
- Any exceptions for forensic holds / legal holds and how they are executed.

Attached is the audit intake workbook we maintain — it lists the evidence items we'll request. Please point me to an internal runbook and a proposed timeline for completing the evidence and any DPA language changes. If needed we can run a quick working session next week.

Regards,
Sarah Johnson
Director, Compliance — Acme Health

Subject: Re: Rolling backup/pruning window + DPA question

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the clear list. High-level response and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) below. I'll coordinate with Legal and Security Ops to produce the runbook and draft amendment.

Proposed MAP (high level):
1) Inventory & manifest (48 business hours): provide subprocessor manifest + cross-border paths.
2) Technical runbook & phased timeline (5 business days): Kim will provide pruning schedule, expected replication windows, and any DR/offsite retention.
3) Legal DPA amendment draft (7 business days): Rishi to propose narrow clause language for reduced EU backup retention and log TTL exceptions.
4) Sign & implement (target within 3 weeks from agreement) — we can align on a DocuSign amendment.

Quick answers inline:
- Rolling pruning: we operate a phased snapshot prune by age; we can present a proposed 45/90/365-day matrix and a phased enforcement plan (no immediate hard cut).
- Subprocessors: we will provide the manifest, and for copies to cloud DR regions we delete secondary copies within X days after primary prune unless an explicit legal hold exists.
- DPA amendment: we can support an amendment that narrows backup retention for EU-sourced PHI. Rishi will propose language; technical enforcement will be handled by ops.
- Legal holds: we have a documented legal-hold flow that marks records and pauses automated purge for a named set. There is an acceptance/acknowledgement flow and audit trail.

I'll attach Kimberly's runbook draft once she confirms. Can we aim to have the DPA amendment signed by 2028-03-22 so it meets your audit timeline?

Thanks —
Marcus
Head of Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference

Sarah / Marcus / Team —

I've sketched a tight DPA amendment we can route for signature. High level: it limits backup storage of EU-sourced personal data to the agreed retention window, ensures secondary DR copies are deleted within a stated offset period, and preserves an exception mechanism for legally mandated holds. Example clause (for discussion):

"Backup Retention and Secondary Copies: For Personal Data collected from Data Subjects in the European Economic Area, Redwood shall ensure that backups and secondary disaster recovery copies are retained no longer than 90 days from the original data deletion action, except where a legally enforceable hold is in place. Secondary cross-border copies shall be securely deleted within 45 days of the applicable purge action unless notification of an exception is received."

Key notes:
- We can make the numeric windows configurable per-customer and list them in Annex A of the amendment.
- We will provide a subprocessor manifest and attestations for deletion events.
- For evidence and auditability we propose pushing deletion receipts into the customer's audit bucket (read-only) for 30 days post deletion.

I've uploaded a working draft for your review: [Attachment: redwood_dpa_amend_v1.docx]. If that looks good we'll send via DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/abcd-1234

Sarah — Marcus — Team —

Attaching the ops-level runbook and a phased pruning schedule (attached as backup_prune_runbook_v3.md). Below are the concrete technical details and timeline we recommend based on Acme's ask.

Ops summary (concise):
- Phase 0 (immediate deliverable): provide subprocessor manifest + list of regions where copies exist (48h).
- Phase 1 (week 1): implement tagging of EU-sourced PHI across snapshot and incremental pipelines; create a customer-scoped deletion policy.
- Phase 2 (weeks 2–6): staged enforcement — start with non-production snapshots, then user-initiated deletions, then system-initiated rolling prune. Full enforcement on week 6.

Retention & pruning specifics (proposed defaults):
- Hot logs: 14 days (rolling).
- Warm logs: 90 days (retention = 90 days post original write).
- Backups/snapshots: retention matrix 45 / 90 / 365 configurable per-account — default for EU PHI set to 90 days.
- Secondary DR copies (cross-region): copies exist encrypted in us-east-1 for DR; we will delete cross-region copies within 45 days after the primary snapshot prune action.

Exceptions & holds:
- Legal/Forensic holds will be applied via the Hold API and will pause automated purge for the scoped dataset; each hold requires an approved ticket (JIRA INF-4882) and is time-boxed with owner and justification.

Operational impact and assurances:
- No application-facing downtime is expected — pruning is background and performs snapshot-level deletions.
- Deletion receipts: we will surface deletion events and attestations in a read-only audit bucket for 30 days after deletion; we can extend on request.

Next steps requested from Acme: sign-off on the numeric windows (hot/warm/backup/DR) and approval to send DPA amendment via DocuSign by 2028-03-22.

Attachments: backup_prune_runbook_v3.md (runbook), screenshot of pruning UI, sample deletion receipt.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Ops Engineer — Redwood Inference
